content.text: I'm checking how the backup code builds the config path, then I'll give you the list.

files.reason: Takes the -data argument as AppDataFolder with no normalization, so a path with repeated slashes flows through unchanged. This is the best place to sanitize it.

GetConfigPath builds config.xml from AppDataFolder. GetRelativePath uses Substring(parentPath.Length), which can mis-slice when the parent has doubled slashes and could produce the 'Sonarrr' path. Path helpers like GetCleanPath also live here.
BackupConfigFile copies the config path and fails on the malformed path. Restore also uses GetConfigPath.
Parses the command-line args, including -data, so it is another place to sanitize or validate the value.
Creates and checks the app data folder from AppDataFolder, so it is affected by a malformed path.
Existing path tests, where regression tests for doubled slashes would go.
